subject: Money
title: Windfall Spending
description: Learn Windfall Spending in one minute.

hook.text: Tax refund? Bonus? Inheritance? People spend unexpected money faster and more frivolously than earned income.

buildup.text: Windfalls are mentally labeled 'free money.' The mental account has no protective friction.

discovery.text: Studies show people spend windfalls 2-3x faster than salary. The source changes the perceived value.

twist.text: Casinos exploit this. Winning chips feel like free money. That's why winners keep betting until they lose.

climax.text: All money is equal. Your brain disagrees. Recognizing this saves you from the windfall trap.

punchline.text: Found money still counts. Treat it like earned.

quiz.question: How fast do people tend to spend windfall money?
options: At the same rate as salary
